meta.title: JoVee — everything you and your band need
meta.desc: Amps, pedals, tuner, drums, looper and metronome for guitar, bass and vocals. macOS, Windows and Linux.
hero.h1: Everything you and your band need.
hero.alt: JoVee Rig with one chain per instrument
tone.h2: Build each instrument's rig with amps, cabs and pedals, in any order you want.
tone.sub: The app's amps and pedals, the .nam captures and IRs you download and the VST3 plugins on your computer, all in the same chain.
tone.c1.p: Guitar, bass and vocals on the same interface, each with its own amp and pedals.
tone.c2.p: Split the signal across two or more amps and mix it back together before the delay.
tone.c3.p: Every amp and pedal opens with its own knobs, which you turn while you play.
tone.l1.p: Download them from TONE3000 inside the app with your key, or load the files you already have.
tone.l2.p: Use the VST3 plugins installed on your computer in the middle of the chain.
tone.l3.p: Send the signal to a pedal on your board and bring it back in the middle of the chain.
prac.h2: Play along with drums, metronome, looper and backing tracks without opening another program.
prac.sub: The drums, the metronome and the delays follow the project's tempo.
prac.c1.p: Play along with 75 drum grooves and call the fill whenever you want.
prac.c2.p: Up to 8 loops per chain playing together in the same bar, with reverse and waveform trimming.
prac.c3.p: Tap the tempo and pick the time signature and the subdivision.
prac.l1.p: The metronome counts you in before you start.
prac.l2.p: Shape your tone while a recorded guitar plays on loop, hands free.
prac.l3.p: Each groove and each backing track switches the guitar to the preset you saved with it.
tools.h2: A tuner for each input and a fader for each output of your interface.
tools.sub: Check tuning, frequencies and levels while you play.
tools.c1.p: One per input: tune one guitar while the other one plays.
tools.c2.p: A fader for each input and output of the interface, adjustable while you play.
tools.c3.p: See in real time the frequencies leaving each output.
tools.l1.p: Shows which block is ruining the tone and which knob to turn.
tools.l2.p: The level of each input and output, with the name of each one.
tools.l3.p: The guitar comes in through one interface and the monitors go out through another.
stage.h2: Switch scenes from a MIDI footswitch without taking your hands off the guitar.
stage.sub: Verse, chorus and solo are saved as scenes of each preset.
stage.c1.p: All the chain's knobs on one screen, in signal order.
stage.c2.p: Play along with rock, blues and funk tracks, slower or in another key.
stage.c3.p: Go back to any of the last 50 versions of each preset.
stage.l1.p: Press the footswitch and choose what it does in the app.
stage.l2.p: Each scene sends PC, CC or SysEx to your other gear.
stage.l3.p: A button shows how long the sound takes from input to output on each chain.
stage.l4.p: Choose between Classic, Neon and Rack.
stage.l5.p: English, Português, Español and six more.
stage.l6.p: On macOS, the app tells you when a new version is out and updates in one click.
fam.sub: Each app does one thing. Rig is available now; the others are coming soon.
fam.studio: Record, edit, mix and finish songs across multiple tracks, with Rig inside.
fam.jam: Play along with the song split into stems, with tab, chords and lyrics.
fam.live: Play live over the internet with up to 6 musicians, each on their own rig and with their own monitor mix.
fam.tone: Recreates a recording's tone by measuring it and sets up Rig or your pedalboard.
fam.lut: Guides your guitar setup step by step, measuring each string by its sound.
cta.h2: Download JoVee Rig and plug in your guitar.
